status: internal design handoff for Tom — not a live form
title: Posfin remortgage questionnaire
purpose: Capture every answer on Ackroyds' historic 6-page remortgage questionnaire (and the usual pre-loan enquiry overlap) via a smart link, save the answers to the CRM, populate the solicitor PDF, and send it for e-signature. The borrower never prints or completes the PDF themselves.

general.title: Remortgage questionnaire
general.subtitle: Posfin Capital
general.footer: Posfin Capital is a broker, not a lender.

ackroyds_posfin_2_0.title: Ackroyds × Posfin 2.0
ackroyds_posfin_2_0.subtitle: Remortgage questionnaire
ackroyds_posfin_2_0.footer: Prepared by Posfin Capital, a broker not a lender, for Ackroyd Legal.
ackroyds_posfin_2_0.branding_note: Use the current Ackroyd Legal logo and name, not the historic 'Stirling Ackroyd Legal' wording that still appears on pages 5–6 of the PDF.

stack_recommendation.brand_switch: A query or path parameter, e.g. /q/:token?brand=general or /q/:token?brand=ackroyds. Same field schema, different chrome, intro copy, Q21 wording, and logos.
stack_recommendation.pdf_fill: Server-side population of Ackroyds' Remortgage Questionnaire.pdf from saved answers, then an e-sign envelope (existing Posfin e-sign flow).
stack_recommendation.capture_alternative: Grok voice call using the same field schema, for borrowers who prefer not to use the link.

rules.never_name_lenders_in_borrower_copy: Do not name the proposed new lender, SM1, SOMO, or any panel lender or insurer in borrower-facing copy. Existing lender names are typed by the borrower, or pre-filled from the title for them to confirm. New-lender name, address and account number are staff-only and are written onto the solicitor PDF at generation time. Insurance ‘interested party’ wording should say ‘the lender’, not a named lender.
rules.no_cifas: Do not mention CIFAS anywhere in the form or surrounding copy.
rules.no_bank_details: Do not ask for card numbers, PINs or online-banking logins. Mortgage account / roll / court references remain required and must be clearly described as such. Exception, added from SM1/Charles Rose title requisition 5.2 (addition C): we do collect the nominated account for the net advance (bank name, account name, sort code, account number), clearly labelled, in the borrower(s) name(s) only. The solicitor’s client account stays off this form.
rules.e_sign_at_end: The web form collects answers and a confirmation only. Signatures on the questionnaire, the leasehold block, and the form of authority are collected in the e-sign envelope, not as wet ink and not inside this app.

sections.title: Welcome
sections.description_general: A few questions about you, the property and your current mortgage. We'll use your answers to prepare the solicitor's forms and send them for e-signature. You will not need to print or fill anything in by hand.
sections.description_ackroyds: Ackroyd Legal will act as your solicitor on this remortgage. Posfin is collecting the answers they need, so we can complete their forms and send them to you for e-signature. You will not need to print or fill in a PDF.

sections.title: About you
sections.description: Please use the full legal names of every borrower — the people who own the property and will be on the new loan.

sections.title: Current mortgages
sections.description: Details of the mortgage and any other charges already secured against the property. We only need mortgage account or roll numbers — not your bank account details.

sections.title: The new loan
sections.description: A few details about the new loan, how it will be used and repaid, any money you will put in yourself, insurance, and when you would like to complete. We already have most of the facility details on file. We will not name the new lender on this form.

sections.title: Who lives there
sections.description: How the property will be occupied on completion, and anyone aged 17 or over other than the borrowers. Occupiers who are not borrowers and not on a tenancy will need to sign occupier documents, which we will send for e-signature.

sections.title: About the property
sections.borrower_title: A few questions about the property
sections.description: These answers also help the solicitor with the enquiries they usually raise later, so asking them now saves time.

sections.title: Building works
sections.description: Including works already done, works you plan to do, and any approvals you hold.

sections.title: Rights and neighbours
sections.borrower_title: Rights, neighbours and when it was built

sections.title: Leasehold
sections.description: These questions only apply if the property is leasehold.

sections.title: Company
sections.description: A few questions that apply when the borrower or a guarantor is a company or LLP.

sections.title: Purchase and gifts
sections.description: These questions only apply if this facility is being used to buy the property. The solicitor will obtain the contract, transfer and replies to requisitions — you do not need to attach those papers here.

sections.title: Account for the net advance
sections.borrower_title: Where should the loan be paid?
sections.description: The account that should receive the net advance, in the borrower(s) name(s). This is not the solicitor’s client account, and we will never ask for a card number or online-banking login.

sections.title: Authority and declaration
sections.description: We'll prepare the solicitor's questionnaire and a form of authority for e-signature. You will not need to print anything. There is also an optional insolvency question, which does not replace searches the solicitor will run.

sections.title: Done
sections.description: We'll prepare your form for e-signature and send you the envelope shortly. You don't need to print anything.

pdf_notes: The source PDF is a 6-page non-fillable scan (OCR via Readiris, dated 24 July 2017). Pages 5–6 still say 'Stirling Ackroyd Legal'. Use current 'Ackroyd Legal' branding on our form.
The PDF typo 'Approximate amount owin2' is 'owing'. 'SPECIAL QUESTONS' is 'questions'.
Telephone numbers on page 1 are laid out as Mr / Ms columns. Our form uses a repeatable borrower group instead, with no gendered columns.

The PDF has only one 'second present lender' block. Cases can have several further charges, so further_charge is repeatable. When populating the PDF, use extra pages or a schedule if there is more than one further charge.
Q9 is three separate yes/no questions (works in the last 4 years; doors/windows since 2002; electrical works since 1 January 2005).
Q11 is a shared details + document request triggered by a yes to Q9 or Q10.
Q5 is not a yes/no on the PDF; it is a conditional document request. We add a clear gate question and do not ask the borrower to post an original certificate.
Q15 only applies if the dwelling was built in the last 10 years. 'Municipal Mutual Foundation 15 Certificate' is historic wording; keep it as an option alongside NHBC.
Page 6 form of authority is in addition to Ackroyds' standalone letter of authority. Prefill it and include both in the e-sign pack until Ackroyds say otherwise.
Signature, print-name and date blocks on pages 4, 5 and 6 are satisfied by the e-sign envelope, not by this web form.
gaps: Ackroyds have not yet confirmed that we may pre-fill and e-sign this historic PDF (rather than a current template or their own e-sign link).

The public Posfin fact-find (posfincapital.com/apply) does not yet cover most of these solicitor questions. The smart link needs to become the system of record for them, writing to Supabase / the CRM.
New-lender account number and payment date are often n/a on a short-term or bridging facility. Confirm PDF wording before typing 'n/a' as fact.
Marital status, mortgage account numbers, ERC details, occupiers at 17+, and most property questions are typically not already on the file.

Client Instruction Form fields (email, date of birth, NI, protocol consent) are recommended extras in this spec but are not on the 6-page questionnaire. Include them in the same smart-link flow if Tom has room.
Fax is a legacy field and should be hidden behind an optional control.
We do not currently have a structured title-to-form mapper in the CRM; prefill from title is a target behaviour, not a live API.

Addition C collects the nominated bank account for the net advance (SM1/Charles Rose title requisition 5.2). This is an intentional exception to the original ‘no bank details’ brief, and must be stored and transmitted as sensitive data.

Addition H assumes a business-purpose facility, which is typical for Posfin. If the same form is later used for a purely residential remortgage, Tom should hide or reword H rather than force the confirmation.
Addition J is optional and does not replace completion-day bankruptcy searches (1.1, 2.2, 9.3), which stay with the solicitor.

The completed questionnaire should pre-populate the Charles Rose / SM1 PLE response column for the solicitor to confirm and sign. The borrower should never fill in that PDF. Map each A–J answer to the PLE number in the CRM.
Do not ask the borrower for unsolicited leases, tenancies, searches or title documents (the title-insurance covering letter tells the solicitor not to send these unless asked).
